about: The world's villages (docs/WORLD_LIFE.md, D12). at is the world cell the square is centred on (world cell = chunk * 64 + cell; y grows south); seed picks the layout and every building's look, so change it to see another village. square and laneLength are [smallest, largest] in cells (1.5 m); houses is the most houses; lanes is 1 (just the road) or 2; stoneInTen is how many buildings in ten are stone (stone doesn't burn).

materials.about: What the buildings are made of, by wall kind and roof cover: terrain ids in rules/materials.json. The walls stand on the footprint's cells (log walls burn to rubble, stone walls stand); the roof carries its material.

windows.about: Window openings are cells of glass in the walls: a terrain id, a window every this many cells along a front (clear of the door), and how many backs in ten have them; each side deep enough has one in its middle. Where they fall follows from each building's seed (VillageLayout).
